articles.summary: Photoroom utilizes Nvidia's TensorRT to optimize background removal in its photo editing apps, achieving up to a 10x performance boost. They detail steps in a blog post, emphasizing TRTorch's efficacy for faster inference speed, particularly in FP16 mode, recommending it over FP32 for reduced inference time.
articles.title: 4 times faster image segmentation with TRTorch

articles.summary: Empowering Android Development with Fast Iterations: Discover how Photoroom's Android team revamped the editing user experience through rapid prototyping, MotionLayout animations, and user testing, showcasing the power of iterative development cycles and user-centric design to enhance app functionality and user satisfaction.
articles.title: Redesigning an Android UI used by millions
